rules.condition: Exact scenario state, identity, fingerprint, method version, cadence, provider policy, and artifact presence/absence match the frozen manifest.
rules.action: Invalidate and stop the scenario on any failed precondition.

rules.condition: Canonical identity, target dates, values, Verification output, or cross-key isolation differs from accepted correctness output.
rules.action: Immediate CORRECTNESS_FAIL; stop escalation. Performance cannot override this gate.

rules.condition: The smallest exact-key Current proof does not produce one owner, zero duplicate computes, canonical responses, and active entry count returning to zero.
rules.action: OWNERSHIP_FAIL or DUPLICATE_WORK_REMAINS; do not authorize larger P03/P11 waves.

rules.condition: The two-caller P08 proof produces more than one full backtest, does not produce one owner plus one waiter, fails correctness, or leaks an entry.
rules.action: Stop Verification escalation. Larger Verification waves remain unauthorized.

rules.condition: A minimal allow-listed COLD precheck for one exact provider key creates duplicate hydration/provider work or violates the provider guard.
rules.action: Set COLD_PROVIDER_ESCALATION_BLOCKED_BY_DUPLICATION and stop larger provider waves.

rules.condition: RSS exceeds 85% of the environment limit, platform memory pressure occurs, post-settlement active entries are nonzero, or completed/failed keys remain retained.
rules.action: Abort cleanly, record memory evidence, classify safety failure, and stop escalation.

rules.condition: DB pool exhaustion or sustained 100% pool saturation for 10 seconds occurs.
rules.action: Abort cleanly and stop escalation; do not tune capacity in Phase 2.2B.

rules.condition: More than 10% failures after ten completions, excluding lawful unavailability, or three consecutive connection failures/503 responses occur.
rules.action: Abort cleanly and stop escalation; defer HTTP capacity diagnosis to Phase 2.2C.

rules.condition: Before the next wave, active requests or in-flight compute are nonzero, CPU has not remained settled for 30 seconds, or post-cooldown memory is missing.
rules.action: Do not start the next wave. Record the blocked safety state.

rules.condition: A race/failure probe produces a wrong, partial-as-ready, cross-key, or semantically divergent persisted artifact.
rules.action: CORRECTNESS_FAIL; stop persistence escalation and preserve diagnostics.

rules.condition: An in-process proof is interpreted as cross-instance duplicate prevention.
rules.action: Classify CROSS_INSTANCE_NOT_PROVEN; prohibit a production-wide exact-once claim.
